reports.scope: Qwen3.5-2B FP32 on one logical Ascend 910C device. Optional early round-zero collection versus delayed collection within the same source. Single and two fixed active requests, matching complete plans, outputs, work and clean caches. Two one-token checks plus four warmups and twelve alternating measurements; 130 forwards total.
reports.limits: Short offline inputs, EOS disabled, eight output tokens, token budget 16, no waiting arrivals. TTFT ends after CPU commit and round cleanup; whole-workload timing includes final draining. Earlier first-result delivery is observed, but no consistent throughput improvement is established. No new full-logit comparison or trace was collected. CPU tests separately cover early EOS, cancellation, partial prefill, callback arrivals and error cleanup.
